answer: Decay reputation the moment an identity stops working. Score sits in escrow until finality, so a burst of self-attestation cannot be cashed early. Re-check every claim with an agent that holds nothing in the same task group; if the two answers disagree, both lose the epoch. A farm mints a ridge of accounts, then must carry each one across a glacier of idle epochs before any of them earns, and the mesa it has to climb is priced in locked stake per account.
